title: RC Dogfood Operational Readiness Golden Path
description: Structured golden-path checklist for dogfood operational readiness review. A technically competent reviewer follows each step. PROMOTE requires all steps with blocking_failure_conditions to be 'passing'. This checklist replaces the previous 'it launches' RC standard with 'usable for real work'.

steps.user_goal: Install or sync the project from source
steps.command_or_ui_action: git clone <repo> && cd rig-relay && uv sync
steps.expected_result: uv sync completes without errors; all dependencies resolve; rig-relay, rig-relay-acp, rig-relay-cockpit entry points are available
blocking_failure_conditions: uv sync fails with dependency resolution error
Any CLI entry point missing or crashes on --help

steps.user_goal: Understand what Rig Relay is and what it is not
steps.expected_result: Reviewer can articulate: Rig Relay is a Python CLI coding assistant with a desktop cockpit frontend; it coordinates agent work with structured evidence; it is alpha software with known blockers and deferred risks
blocking_failure_conditions: README.md is missing or fails to explain what Rig Relay is
README.md does not describe server/frontend architecture
README.md does not state frontend is the primary product surface
README.md does not describe current alpha scope

steps.expected_result: ACP server starts, binds to configured port, logs startup message without fatal errors
blocking_failure_conditions: Server crashes on startup
Server fails to bind port
Server logs fatal error within first 30 seconds

steps.user_goal: Launch the frontend cockpit as the primary product surface
steps.command_or_ui_action: uv run rig-relay (launches Textual desktop cockpit)
steps.expected_result: Desktop cockpit TUI launches; frontend/index.html renders; cockpit displays agent status, tool output, and coordination state
blocking_failure_conditions: Cockpit crashes on startup
Cockpit fails to connect to ACP server
Cockpit renders blank or unresponsive
Frontend HTML fails to load in browser

steps.user_goal: Confirm frontend is the primary product surface (not CLI-only)
steps.command_or_ui_action: Interact with cockpit UI: view agent state, inspect tool output, navigate tabs/panels
steps.expected_result: All primary interaction flows are available through the cockpit UI; CLI exists as debug/admin shim only
blocking_failure_conditions: Critical workflow requires CLI and has no cockpit UI path
Cockpit is a thin wrapper that delegates all interaction to CLI

steps.user_goal: Run or coordinate a real bounded work lane through the agent
steps.command_or_ui_action: Submit a bounded task (e.g. 'list files in src/') through the cockpit or ACP; observe agent loop execute tools and produce output
steps.expected_result: Agent processes the task, invokes tools, produces structured output; tool receipts are recorded in observability; session completes without hanging
blocking_failure_conditions: Agent hangs indefinitely on simple task
Tool invocation crashes the session
No observability data emitted for a completed session
Agent loop produces incoherent or empty output

steps.user_goal: Observe runtime accountability for feral subprocesses (timeout, cancel, partial output, process death)
steps.command_or_ui_action: Submit a task that spawns a long-running subprocess; observe timeout behavior, cancellation, and partial output capture
steps.expected_result: Timeout triggers clean cancellation; partial output is captured before timeout; process death is recorded in telemetry; large output is bounded
blocking_failure_conditions: Subprocess timeout leaves orphaned process
Cancellation does not close tracing spans
Process death is silently ignored
Large output exceeds bounds without truncation
No tests exist proving any of the above
steps.reviewer_notes: PASSING: 8 adversarial tests prove timeout partial output capture, cancellation terminal event uniqueness, process death recording, large output truncation, fake secret exclusion from terminal evidence, and timeout orphan cleanup. 10 additional sabotage tests prove span closure exactly once and duplicate completion idempotency. 26 tests total pass with real subprocesses. blk_runtime_feral_subprocess resolved.

steps.user_goal: Verify bash rerouting transparency — when bash is transparently rerouted to a safer tool, receipts record original command, rerouted tool, and permission decision
steps.command_or_ui_action: Submit a task that triggers bash rerouting (e.g. 'cat README.md' which reroutes to read_file); inspect the tool receipt
steps.expected_result: Tool receipt records: original command category, rerouted tool name, permission decision, whether raw bash was skipped
blocking_failure_conditions: Bash rerouting occurs silently with no receipt trace
Receipt does not distinguish rerouted from raw bash execution
Permission decision is not recorded in receipt
No tests exist proving rerouting transparency
steps.reviewer_notes: RESOLVED: blk_bash_rerouting_transparency closed. Schema updated with reroute property (oneOf: object with 12 fields including was_rerouted, raw_bash_skipped, original_command_category, rerouted_tool_name, permission_decision, final_outcome, redaction_status, or null). BashReceipt/BashResult models updated with reroute field. Bash.build_receipt propagates reroute metadata. 20 tests cover: model defaults/serialization, cat/grep/git_status reroute detection, non-rerouted commands, permission refusal, dangerous pattern detection ($() / backticks), build_receipt propagation (with/without/null reroute). Verified with test suite and schema validation.

steps.user_goal: Verify telemetry-disabled degradation is visible and non-destructive
steps.command_or_ui_action: Launch with telemetry disabled (RIG_TELEMETRY_ENABLED=0); run a task; inspect observability output
steps.expected_result: Observability file is empty or contains only a degradation marker; agent loop functions normally; no crash or hang due to missing telemetry
blocking_failure_conditions: Telemetry-disabled mode crashes the agent loop
Telemetry-disabled mode hangs on telemetry flush
Telemetry-disabled mode produces corrupted observability
No degradation marker distinguishes disabled from empty telemetry
No tests exist proving degradation visibility
steps.reviewer_notes: Blocker blk_telemetry_disabled_degradation RESOLVED by parallel telemetry lane. Degradation gating, marker, 17 tests. Step status changed from blocked to not_verified — reviewer must verify tests pass.

steps.user_goal: Verify context assembler / context envelope is available for agent context construction, including digestion and cache
steps.command_or_ui_action: Run a task that invokes rig.get_context with ContextMode.DIGEST; inspect that digest packet is assembled from cache hits, coordination store projection, and repo index
steps.expected_result: ContextDigester produces structured digest packet; ContextCache serves cache hits; digester gracefully falls back to coordination store projection when unavailable; agent receives assembled context
blocking_failure_conditions: Context assembler crashes on invocation
Context packet is empty or missing required sections
Digestion mode produces incoherent output
Cache returns stale or incorrect data
steps.reviewer_notes: ContextDigester implemented (rig_relay/context/digester.py). ContextCache implemented (rig_relay/context/cache.py). risk_digestion_pipeline and risk_context_cache resolved. Reviewer must verify with live run.

steps.user_goal: Inspect structured evidence (JSON/JSONL receipts, not Markdown)
steps.command_or_ui_action: After running a work lane, inspect ~/.rig/relay/sessions/<id>/observability.jsonl and .rig/reports/reports.jsonl
steps.expected_result: Observability file contains valid JSONL with tool receipts, session lifecycle events; reports file contains append-only structured reports; no Markdown files masquerade as evidence
blocking_failure_conditions: Observability file is malformed JSONL
Evidence is written as Markdown instead of JSON/JSONL/CSV
Receipts are missing required fields (sha256, timestamp, tool_name)
Reports file is not append-only (existing rows modified)

steps.user_goal: Confirm no Markdown-as-evidence leakage in the golden path
steps.command_or_ui_action: Run the release-gate validator; verify no forbidden Markdown paths appear in required_evidence for any phase
steps.expected_result: Validator reports zero forbidden Markdown evidence paths; all evidence is JSON/JSONL/CSV or allowed Markdown exceptions
blocking_failure_conditions: Golden path references a .md file as canonical evidence (outside allowed exceptions)
Validator does not check for Markdown evidence leakage

steps.user_goal: Verify debug packets are quarantined separately from production telemetry
steps.command_or_ui_action: Run a task with debug flags enabled; inspect that debug packets land in quarantine storage, not in production telemetry bundle
steps.expected_result: Debug packets are stored in separate quarantine path; production bundle excludes debug packets; quarantine manifest is inspectable
blocking_failure_conditions: Debug packets appear in production telemetry bundle
Quarantine storage is not implemented
No quarantine manifest reporting exists
No tests exist proving quarantine separation
steps.reviewer_notes: Blocker blk_debug_packet_quarantine RESOLVED by parallel telemetry lane. Quarantine boundary, packet hash tracking, debug export gating, 14 tests. Step status changed from blocked to not_verified — reviewer must verify tests pass.

steps.user_goal: Verify coordination state is watchable (polling watcher detects ledger changes)
steps.command_or_ui_action: After running a work lane, verify the CoordinationWatcher detects new events and stale leases; inspect watch events
steps.expected_result: CoordinationWatcher emits structured CoordinationWatchEvent for ledger changes; stale lease detection works; session state changes are detected
blocking_failure_conditions: Coordination store is empty after a session that claimed leases
Coordination ledger is malformed or corrupted
CoordinationWatcher fails to detect new events
steps.reviewer_notes: CoordinationWatcher implemented (rig_relay/coordination/watcher.py). Tests at tests/coordination/test_watcher.py. risk_watchable_backends resolved. Reviewer must verify with live run.

steps.user_goal: Shut down the server and cockpit cleanly
steps.command_or_ui_action: Send SIGTERM or use cockpit quit command; observe shutdown sequence
steps.expected_result: Server closes all sessions cleanly; cockpit saves state; no orphaned subprocesses; no corrupted state files
blocking_failure_conditions: Server leaves orphaned subprocesses after shutdown
Cockpit crashes on quit
State files are corrupted after unclean shutdown
Active sessions are abandoned without closeout events

steps.user_goal: Understand what is blocked, deferred, or unsafe in the current RC
steps.expected_result: All open blockers are documented with severity, phase, and required resolution; deferred risks have clear deferral justifications; no dogfood-essential capability is hidden as deferred
blocking_failure_conditions: A dogfood-essential capability is classified as deferred without justification
Open blockers lack required resolution descriptions
Deferred risks lack deferral reasons

steps.user_goal: Run the release gate validator and confirm it correctly reflects dogfood readiness
steps.expected_result: Validator returns verdict BLOCKED or FAIL (not PASS) while golden path has blocking steps; validator checks golden path status as part of verdict computation
blocking_failure_conditions: Validator returns PASS while golden path has blocking steps
Validator does not check golden path status
Validator does not distinguish installability from dogfood readiness
